title: read + listing endpoints
instruction: Add `GET /api/grants` returning all grants. Add `GET /api/claims` (authenticated with `Authorization: Token <token>`) returning the authenticated user's claims, newest first, with an optional `?status=active|voided` query filter.

title: budget adjustment
instruction: Add `POST /api/grants/{grantId}/adjust-budget` accepting `{ "deltaCents": <integer> }` that increases or decreases the grant's `budgetCents` and returns the updated grant. Reject with 409 if the new budget would be below the amount already awarded to active claims. Budget/limit checks and summaries use the new budget.

title: audit log
instruction: Add an append-only audit log recording every claim creation and every void, exposed via `GET /api/grants/{grantId}/audit` returning `{ "type": "claim_created"|"claim_voided", "claimId": string, "userId": string, "at": ISO-8601 }` in chronological order.

title: reporting + claim versioning
instruction: Add `GET /api/grants/{grantId}/report` returning `{ "perUser": [{ "userId": string, "activeClaimCount": int, "awardedCents": int }], "totalActiveClaims": int, "totalAwardedCents": int }`. Add a `version` integer to every claim that starts at 1 and increments on each mutation (void increments it).
